blurb: Guests fish for ground fish like haddock, cod, redfish, pollock, and can also see seabirds, seals, and possibly whales. Trips include offshore, inshore, tuna fishing, and striper fly fishing. All gear, bait, fishing licenses, and instruction are provided; guests bring snacks and drinks.
extraNote: 50% deposit required to secure booking · No refunds within 15 days of the trip · Full refund if cancelled by captain or due to weather and trip cannot be rescheduled · Payment expected on day of charter · Tipping customary 15%-20% · Charter can be cut short at captain's discretion for irresponsible alcohol use
